  n_2 -. dotted .-> End([x < y])
  B{Ünï}

swimlane-beta TB
  subgraph L3["Customer"]
    End>Run tests]
    n_2([Plan])
    Ünï[(Ship it)]
  end
  subgraph L3["Ünï Team"]
    A{Ship it}
    Ünï[$$E=mc2$$]
  end
  subgraph L2["Ops"]
    A([Ünï])
    A((**bold** step))
    End@{ shape: hourglass }
  end
  x1 --x|cross| A[/Plan\]
  n_2 -.- 漢(tab	here)
  D -- text --> Start[/Ünï\]
  D --x|cross| Ünï[[long label that keeps going well past the wrapping width]]
  漢[(**bold** step)]
